logic.bm: Transformers are a small line inside a cable-led group. Bahra-TBS plant: oil-immersed distribution transformers (BOIT) up to 36 kV, 50–2,500 kVA and >2,500–5,000 kVA, ONAN, Cu/Al windings, oval cores; "production capacity to produce 3,500 units/year"; SEC-spec (51-SDMS) three-phase pad-mounted and pole-mounted units, unit substations 300–1,500 kVA (56-SDMS), KNAN ester units, package substations (RMU bought from SEC-approved makers). Cast-resin dry-type 100–5,000 kVA up to 36 kV (Legrand-licensed design, CESI type-tested). Also busways, LV panels, and (main business) LV/MV/HV cables, building wires, OPGW, wiring devices, cable trays, Al/Cu rods.
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

body.name: Bahra Electric

capacity_indicators: Oil-immersed transformers: "production capacity to produce 3,500 units/year" (product page, accessed 2026-09-25)
profile.end_markets: Saudi Arabia (giga-projects: Red Sea, Amaala, Diriyah, Qiddiyah; Saudi Aramco; utilities), GCC & Middle East since 2014, then Africa, parts of Europe and Asia — "exported its products to more than 50+ countries" (mostly cables). Note: in SEC's "List of Prequalified Manufacturers/Suppliers for Distribution Networks Materials Till March 2024", Bahra appears for cables/rods but NOT among prequalified distribution-transformer makers (items 39.x).
profile.owners: Bahra Electric group ("Started as Bahra Cables in 2008, now Bahra Electric encompasses a group of companies": Bahra Cables, Bahra Electrical Equipment, Bahra Metals, Bahra Electrical Devices, Transformers & Busways Solutions, FAME). Shareholders not disclosed.
